selection: Equal primary-threshold/year Brier among continuous-CDF candidates only; held-out thresholds are diagnostics, not selection inputs

baselines.persistence_group: rain_sum_15m bins [0,0.1,0.5,2,5,10] plus current wet flag

inference_threshold_domain: any finite nonnegative threshold representable as Decimal(38,18); performance checked at nine development thresholds in 0..5 mm; higher-tail predictions are empirical, not a validated extreme-tail guarantee

group_evaluation.stations: five largest first-fold TRAIN station counts, frozen before metrics

test_policy: No new 2024 selection or scoring; preserve v1 known test. Final new model refits 2017..2023 after development lock and reports development validation as evidence.
probability_postprocessing: Conditional empirical survival CDF with fixed training-only global-prior mixture; structurally nonincreasing in threshold. No validation/test outcome calibration.
